name: Left behind
description:
Did the attacker leave something behind?

**Contexto del reto:**
Life went on and you all but forgot about those gaming days. However, a few days ago, you noticed that your computer was quite sluggish and when you checked the task manager, one program kept using a lot of CPU even though you were not doing anything: the SSH server. You became curious and searched the internet for ways to discover what an SSH server is and why it could be using so much processing power. One of the articles mentioned that a lot of connections on the internet are simply scanners trying to find vulnerable machines for their malicious purposes. This article also mentioned that honeypots are a means to gain insight into what the person trying to connect wants to do. You downloaded Cowrie for this purpose, into `/home/cowrie/cowrie`. Connect to the computer at `172.20.0.202` with the credentials `root:alpine`, configure Cowrie and follow the connecting party's steps.

name: Destination: undefined
description:
Ronnie might be to telling you to go somewhere. Where would that be? The answer should contain an English word.
<details><summary>Hint 1</summary>The ciphertext looks like a URL. Focus on decrypting the first part first (before the scheme separator), since there are not that many schemes commonly used.</details>
<details><summary>Hint 2</summary>When decrypting the ciphertext, consider the fact that most alphabetic ciphers completely ignore non-alphabetic characters and act as if they were not there at all.</details>
<details><summary>Hint 3</summary>The key is also an English word.</details>

**Contexto del reto:**
"B1G_C0MP... Big Comp... Wasn't that the company your cousin Ronnie was investigating shortly before getting arrested?", you think. Those were the times, really. You just spent your days gaming. You feel nostalgic about the discussions you used to have with him and have the sudden urge to relive your last conversation. The chat is available at `http://172.20.0.205`. Visit this page and find out whether there are any hidden messages.
